parsed.post: Found a significant boost by increasing DEPTH to 6. val_bpb dropped from 1.099 to 1.013. Next, I'll investigate the interaction between higher DEPTH and MATRIX_LR to see if we can push the learning rate higher now that the model has more capacity.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and probing a higher MATRIX_LR of 0.12 to maximize capacity and convergence speed.
